title: Stop Indexing at Full Precision: Revisiting Clustering for Vector Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2608.14648v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this study, we revisit three widely used techniques in vector search and utilize them to optimize vector embedding indexing through clustering: dimensionality reduction, quantization, and dimension pruning. We propose an indexing pipeline in which these techniques are applied before clustering, and we focus on how they affect storage footprint, clustering time, and the quality of the resulting centroids for vector search tasks. Our results reveal that using full-precision vectors for clustering is excessive, as even 1-bit codes can achieve near-optimal clustering quality (within 1% of ideal) while reducing storage requirements by 60x and delivering attractive performance gains (Figure 1). We open-source our implementations at https://github.com/cwida/SuperKMeans.

translated_title: 停止全精度索引：重新审视向量嵌入的聚类方法
translated_abstract: 本研究重新审视了向量搜索中三种广泛使用的技术，并利用它们通过聚类优化向量嵌入索引：降维、量化和维度剪枝。我们提出了一种索引流水线，在这些技术应用于聚类之前进行处理，并重点研究了它们对存储占用、聚类时间以及最终质心质量在向量搜索任务中的影响。我们的结果表明，使用全精度向量进行聚类是过度的，因为即使是1位编码也能实现接近最优的聚类质量（在理想值的1%以内），同时将存储需求减少60倍，并提供显著的性能提升（见图1）。我们在https://github.com/cwida/SuperKMeans开源了我们的实现。
tldr: 本研究提出在聚类前应用降维、量化和维度剪枝技术，证明1位编码即可达到接近最优的聚类质量，显著降低存储需求并提升性能。
en_tdlr: This study proposes applying dimensionality reduction, quantization, and dimension pruning before clustering, demonstrating that 1-bit codes can achieve near-optimal clustering quality, drastically reducing storage and boosting performance.
